# Topological_Dirac_Mode

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
A Dirac-type eigenmode localized or protected by the topology of a networked system, often arising at boundaries or interfaces. Such modes offer robust signal localization and routing primitives for TCC architectures that exploit topological invariants.
